title: 'We'll get home one day' - US travellers impacted by nationwide ground stop
description: Passengers throughout the country were impacted over what the Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) describes as “safety and communication issues”.
text: US flights are allowed to take off again after a ground stop halted flights nationwide for hours due to an air traffic control communications issue.
Travellers throughout the country were impacted over what the Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) describes as “safety and communication issues”.
